centerSubtitle: Your documents, choices and controls in one place.
translationNotice: Legal documents are shown in English, which is the authoritative version.
reviewBanner: Draft: this document is still under legal review.

consents.title: Your consents
consents.requiredBody: These can only be withdrawn by deleting your account.
consents.optionalBody: PitchProof works without these. You can change them at any time.
consents.failed: Your choice could not be saved. Please try again.

ai.label: AI analysis of my videos
ai.description: Frames from videos you choose are analysed by AI providers that may not keep or train on them.
ai.guardianLocked: Your parent or guardian has not allowed AI analysis.

gate.title: Before you start
gate.body: Please read the short summaries below. The full documents are always available in the Privacy Center.
gate.reacceptBody: We made important changes. Please review and accept them to keep using PitchProof.
gate.agree: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service, the Privacy Policy and the Community Guidelines.
gate.optionalLater: Optional choices, such as AI analysis, are asked separately and can be changed in the Privacy Center.

movement.title: Movement sessions
movement.body: While you record a session, your phone's position is used to measure distance and draw a pitch heatmap. It is converted on your device and never stored or uploaded. Only the distance, speeds and heatmap are saved.

report.title: Report a problem
report.body: Use Report on any profile, video, Passport, request or trial. Reports about young players are reviewed first.

export.title: Download your data
export.body: Get a copy of the personal data PitchProof holds about you as a JSON file: profile, Passport, matches, analyses, coaching, movement sessions (pitch only, no location), media details with download links, scouting data and consent records.
export.working: Your download is being prepared. This page updates when it is ready.
export.failed: Your download could not be prepared. Please try again.
export.signInAgain: For your security, please sign out and sign in again, then request your download within 10 minutes.

requests.title: Privacy requests
requests.body: Ask PitchProof to act on your data rights. We reply within 30 days.

hints.access: You can also download your data right away above.
hints.correction: Tell us what is wrong. You can edit most details yourself in your profile.
hints.deletion: You can delete your account yourself at any time in Settings.
hints.portability: The download above is in a machine-readable format you can take elsewhere.
hints.objection: Tell us which processing you object to and why.
hints.withdrawal: Optional consents can be switched off directly in the consents section above.

requests.failed: Your request could not be sent. Please try again.

steps.derived_deleted: Removing you from other people's lists

deletion.keepOpen: Keep PitchProof open until this finishes.
deletion.retry: Deletion paused. Tap Delete account again to continue where it stopped.
